Now case facts: The defendant (上诉人海某) committed multiple thefts of electric cables (public telecommunication/electric facilities). This is theft of public telecommunication facilities? The law: theft of public telecommunication facilities (破坏公用电信设施罪) maybe. The earlier example: "破坏广播电视设施、公用电信设施;盗窃". So they charged both theft and destruction of facilities. In the first example, they had both charges. So here we likely have "盗窃" and "破坏公用电信设施". Also there is illegal handling of seized property: He stole a car that was under court seizure. That's "非法处置扣押的财产" which is a crime: "非法处置扣押的财产罪" (illegal disposal of seized property). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "非法处置查封、扣押、冻结的财产" (Article 277). So we need charge for that.

Thus charges: 盗窃 (theft), 破坏公用电信设施 (damage to public telecommunication facilities), 非法处置扣押的财产 (illegal disposal of seized property). Possibly also "寻衅滋事" but that's prior conviction, not part of this case.

Also maybe "诈骗" no. He didn't defraud, just stole.

Thus final answer list: [罪名]盗窃;破坏公用电信设施;非法处置扣押的财产<eoa>
